cashflow_audit_revision.scale_rule: Nguồn báo cáo bằng Ngàn VND; chia 1.000 để đưa về triệu VND, sau đó làm tròn gần nhất ở snapshot. Giá trị nguyên nguồn được lưu trong metadata.
cashflow_audit_revision.selected_basis: Later H1/2024 comparative selected; CFO/CFI classification changes materially vs original H1 report, while net and close differ within 0.01%.

cashflow_source_reconciliation.quarter_values_basis: current selected YTD minus prior quarter YTD
cashflow_source_reconciliation.foreign_exchange_effect_source: No separate FX bridge line identified in these cash-flow statement pages; leave FX null and do not infer a plug.
cashflow_source_reconciliation.source_reclassification_note: Later H1/2024 comparative selected; CFO/CFI classification changes materially vs original H1 report, while net and close differ within 0.01%.
